title: Comptime Patterns
concept: Advanced comptime patterns: static reflection, type-level programming, lookup tables, and compile-time code generation for zero-overhead abstractions.
why: Generic code has bounds. Comptime code has none. Anything you can express algorithmically at comptime becomes a zero-cost abstraction at runtime.
tips: Comptime lookup tables eliminate runtime computation — ideal for embedded and real-time systems
Static reflection enables automatic serialization, validation, and documentation generation
Compile-time assertions catch configuration errors before the binary is built
Platform-specific comptime code enables single-source cross-platform builds
common_mistakes: Bloat: generating huge lookup tables that increase binary size significantly
Over-engineering: using comptime for trivial computations that are already fast at runtime
Forgetting that comptime has limited I/O — can't read arbitrary files or make network calls
